talk.name: talk
talk.task_message:
Say exactly this text: "{{say}}"
Say exactly this text. Never promise a transfer, a callback or any other action that the text does not state. Do not call any tool.

extraction_schema.name: who
extraction_schema.description: Only from the customer's LAST message, about who is on the line. confirmed: says yes, that's me, speaking, or says the customer's own name. not_customer: says they are someone else (a relative, a partner, a colleague) or that the customer is not there/available. unclear: hello, go ahead, who is this, or anything else. none: not about who is speaking.

extraction_schema.name: question
extraction_schema.description: A question in the LAST message. robot: asks if this is a robot or AI. scam: asks if this is a scam or a real call. purpose: asks what the call is about or why we call. cannot_answer: any other question about facts (fees, interest, balance history, why the amount is this). none: no question.

extraction_schema.name: intent
extraction_schema.description: What the LAST message does. paid: says they already paid this past-due amount. dispute: says the debt is not theirs, they never had the product, or it was closed or paid off in the past. plan: explicitly asks for a new payment plan, instalments or lower instalments (naming a date is not a plan). hardship: mentions illness, a death in the family or job loss. too_much: says the full amount is too much or they cannot afford all of it. discount: asks for a discount, waiver or lower price. human: asks for a human, a person, an agent. stop_talking: says they do not want to talk / end this call. refuse: refuses to pay or refuses to answer the security question, with no date and no amount. vague: gives a vague period (next week, end of the month, when my salary comes) without an exact day. accept: agrees to what was proposed. wrong_number: says this number does not belong to the customer. deceased: says the customer has died. change_promise: wants to change or cancel a recorded promise. incomplete: the message stops mid-sentence. other: anything else. none: nothing of these.

extraction_schema.name: answer
extraction_schema.description: yes or no answer in the LAST message to the agent's last yes/no question (for example 'Can you make this payment today?', 'Do you confirm?', 'Could you pay X on Y?'). none if neither.

extraction_schema.name: date_words
extraction_schema.description: The day the customer names in the LAST message as a future payment or callback day, copied in their own words (for example 'tomorrow', 'next Friday', 'this Friday', 'the 20th', 'October 23'). Write none when no day is named, and none for a past payment date.

extraction_schema.name: time_words
extraction_schema.description: A clock time the customer names in the LAST message for a callback, in their words (for example 'eleven in the morning', '3 pm', '15:30'). none if no time.

extraction_schema.name: amount_said
extraction_schema.description: An amount of money the customer says in the LAST message they can pay, as a plain number like 120 or 75.50. none if no amount.

extraction_schema.name: dob_day
extraction_schema.description: Day of month of the customer's date of birth said in the LAST message, as digits (1-31). A date said only in numbers is day, then month, then year. none if not said.

extraction_schema.name: dob_month
extraction_schema.description: Month of the customer's date of birth said in the LAST message, as a number 1-12 (March is 3). A date said only in numbers is day, then month, then year. none if not said.

extraction_schema.name: dob_year
extraction_schema.description: Year of the customer's date of birth said in the LAST message, as four digits. none if not said.

extraction_schema.name: phone_digits
extraction_schema.description: Digits of the phone number the customer says in the LAST message, digits only (for example 4821). none if no digits.

function.name: get_account
function.description: The late products. Refused until both questions are passed.

function.name: create_promise
function.description: Record a payment promise. One per product.

function.name: verify_identity
function.description: Check one security answer. Three wrong answers in total end the check.

function.name: transfer_to_agent
function.description: Hand the call to a person.

function.name: close_call
function.description: End the call. Always the last tool call. Nothing is accepted after it.

function.name: end_call
function.description:
This is used to technically terminate the call after all the customer's questions have been answered and necessary information has been provided.
- It should only be triggered SILENTLY in the background after the customer-related workflow is complete; never mention this tool or its name to the customer.

llmConfig.systemPrompt: You are a helpful assistant. Your role is to help users with their tasks. Always be friendly and professional. You can use `end_call` tool after you say goodbye to customer to hang up if call about to finish.

workflow.system_prompt: You are the digital assistant of Freya Bank on a phone call. Speak English. Say exactly the text you are given, nothing more.
